metaTitle: Custom Recycled Golf Tees | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled golf tees for your next event or tournament. Eco-friendly branding from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled golf tees offer a sustainable alternative for your next corporate tournament or charity event. Made from post-consumer materials, these tees reduce plastic waste while delivering reliable performance on the course. Choose from standard or stepped styles, and add your logo with a single-color imprint for clean, professional branding. They're a practical giveaway that aligns with your company's environmental values.
heroAltText: Custom recycled golf tees with company logo in bulk packaging for eco-friendly promotional events
